name: [short][work-software] microservice_migration_planning

conversation.content: We're finally migrating our monolith to microservices. Thinking of using Docker and Kubernetes for orchestration.
Great choice. How are you handling CI/CD?
I've been leaning towards GitHub Actions. It integrates well with our repo.
Solid. What's your timeline for the first service?
We're aiming to have the first microservice deployed by the end of next sprint.

golden_facts: The user is using Docker and Kubernetes for microservices orchestration.
The user prefers GitHub Actions as their CI/CD tool.
The user plans to deploy the first microservice by the end of the next sprint.
